---
name: Result or documentation question
about: Flag an unclear comparison, provenance gap or incorrect interpretation
title: "Evidence: "
labels: ''
assignees: ''
---

Which page, result row, run ID or commit are you referring to?

What claim seems wrong or unclear? What did you expect instead?

Are the inputs, codec versions, block sizes, threads and machines comparable?
It is fine if you cannot determine this; say which information is missing.

If you ran a check, include its command and a short relevant output excerpt.
No benchmark rerun is required to report a documentation error.

Do not attach private data, credentials or full environment dumps.
